units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 7:12">Targ. Ps. VII, 12</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 94b:10">Keth. 94ᵇ</cite> <he>אנא ד׳ וכ׳</he> I am an authorized judge &c.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 7b:6">Snh. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>אוקמו ד׳ דלא וכ׳</he> appointed a judge (lecturer) who had not studied; a. fr.—Pl. <he>דַּיָּינִין</he>, <he>דַּיָּינַיָּא</he>, <cite ref="D00561"><he>דַּיָּ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 16:18">Targ. Deut. XVI, 18</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bava Batra 29a:17">B. Bath. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>ד׳ דשפלי דָיְינֵי הכי</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>ד׳ דשיפלי הכי דָאִינֵי</he>) ignorant judges will so decide; <cite ref="Bava Batra 133b:2">ib. 133ᵇ</cite> <he>ד׳ דחצצתא וכ׳</he> compromising judges (who know not the law) &c.; a. fr.
